title: Commonwealth Grants Commission Amendment (GST Distribution) Bill 2015
short_title: Commonwealth Grants Commission Amendment (GST Distribution) Bill 2015

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would change how the Commonwealth Grants Commission (CGC) takes mining revenue into account when recommending distribution of goods and services tax (GST) revenue.
The CGC would use only the latest financial year for which mining revenue data is available, replacing the use of older years in the assessment.
The restriction would cover relevant inquiries into state and territory GST distribution, while retaining the existing equalisation principle and other aspects of the distribution arrangements.
changes: A statutory rule would require mining revenue assessments to use the most recent available financial year.
Mining revenue from earlier financial years would be excluded from that part of the calculation.
The new rule would begin the day after Royal Assent.
summary.affected: State and territory governments receiving GST revenue and the CGC preparing distribution recommendations would be affected.
